_doc: Posts at the Colfax / Sherman junction read BY EYE (Claude, 2026-11-23) off the 2022 3-inch aerial at 2x, window px x 1500-2140, y 290-870 of the pilot mosaic. Pixel picks, about +-0.5 m; no second source. 'candidate' is the shadow reader's kept candidate index when it found the same post (pilot/poles.json 'k'), null when it missed it. This is the ground truth the shadow reader's recall and precision are measured against, for this one junction only.
